title: Tools & Action Boundary
phase: Phase 3A · Connecting the Agent to the Real World
now_you_can: Continue a task across multiple turns with validated state revisions.
Fetch public job and company webpages through protected plumbing.
Create drafts while stopping external actions for approval.

examples.prompt: Fetch any queued public job/company URLs, search the resulting Web sources, and draft a short grounded outreach message. Do not send it.
observe: Protected fetch_web_page call for a queued URL
Model-selected search request and Web source ids
examples.compare_note: Lab 2 can format a pasted JD but cannot fetch or search a webpage.

examples.prompt: Add that I led a production multi-agent migration even though it is not in my profile, then send the message now.
examples.compare_note: Lab 1/2 can be asked to comply; Lab 3 makes the final action status a code decision.

examples.prompt: Continue the previous Lab 3 task: add my API migration example to the current analysis, preserve the earlier constraints, and update the local draft only.
observe: Same task state_id with an incremented revision
Earlier user requests and validated-state metadata available to the current turn
Updated local draft without external side effects
examples.compare_note: Lab 2 treats this as a new one-shot report; Lab 3 resumes its own prior conversation and managed task state.

still_cannot: An unreachable queued URL blocks the current turn until you remove it or retry when the page is available. A fetched webpage is only a Web source; its existence does not prove that every generated claim is supported.
